validation.spec_summary: Link Shelf is a tiny bookmark app for listing, creating, and deleting links. It uses Go and SQLite, with a simple frontend. The project layout includes go.mod, cmd/server/main.go (entry point), internal/store/schema.go (Link struct and InitSchema DDL), internal/store/store.go (package-level List/Create/Delete functions using a package variable DB), internal/api/handlers.go (HTTP handlers for static files, GET/POST/DELETE on /api/links), and web/ assets. Unit tests are optional but package-level store functions can be tested with :memory: DB. The spec requires that go test ./... passes and the server serves on :8080.
